title: Master Creative Tools - Photoshop for Beginners | Lesson 3
summary: This PiXimperfect lesson introduces core Photoshop creative tools for beginners through hands‑on brushing, coloring, and non‑destructive editing techniques. The video demonstrates painting with the brush on different blend modes (notably Difference) to reveal interaction with underlying colors, switching between foreground and background colors, and using new layers to keep edits non‑destructive. It covers essential brush fundamentals (tip shapes, opacity vs flow, and smoothing), practical shortcuts ( Bracket keys for size; tilde for erasing while painting; keyboard shortcuts for tools), and the Rotate View/Sticky Shortcuts workflow that accelerates tool switching. The session also dives into removal and healing workflows (Remove Tool, Patch Tool, Content‑Aware Fill) with both manual and AI‑assisted options, and culminates with advanced selection techniques (Lasso, Select Subject, Object Selection with cloud vs device processing) and quick background removal via masks and adjustment layers. The overall message encourages experimentation and non‑destructive practice using practice files or personal images.
topics: X key to swap foreground/background colors
Rotate View Tool (R) as a sticky shortcut
Sticky shortcuts for tool switching (R, L, J, etc.)
Opacity/flow vs brush interaction on layers
Find distractions (People, Wires) in Remove Tool
Generative AI options in Remove Tool
Object Finder and cloud vs device processing
Generative Fill (Firefly) and upscaling in properties
